# The content-script compatibility preference keeps two tests on the old injection policy

The original test-only setup enables extensions.webextensions.allow_executeScript_in_moz_extension in both content-script and popup-cookie-store files and clears the user preference during cleanup. This deliberately restores the old injection behavior while default-restriction compatibility is deferred. Accepted source later removes this setup and the original tabs-content file is absent; this does not establish a production setting or a fresh policy test.

Scope: extension-content-script-tests.
